title: Crashes at the moment of project creating in Debian OS
body:
### Tested versions

v4.4.1-stable_linux.x86_64

### System information

Debian 11 + LXDE

### Issue description

Crashes occur during the project creation.

### Steps to reproduce

I just wanted to meet Godot. Downloaded the first time, ran and tried to create a project. The application crashed. In the project directory, I've seen two files: icon.svg and project.godot.
The second time I ran the application in CLI. The application has shown me a created project, I've just clicked on the "Edit" button and the application crashed again and I get this output:

```
$ ./Godot_v4.4.1-stable_linux.x86_64 
Godot Engine v4.4.1.stable.official.49a5bc7b6 - https://godotengine.org
WARNING: Could not set V-Sync mode, as changing V-Sync mode is not supported by the graphics driver.
     at: set_use_vsync (platform/linuxbsd/x11/gl_manager_x11.cpp:360)
OpenGL API 4.5 (Core Profile) Mesa 20.3.5 - Compatibility - Using Device: Mesa/X.org - llvmpipe (LLVM 11.0.1, 256 bits)

Editing project: /media/destructor/Projects/CSharp/Testgodot
Godot Engine v4.4.1.stable.official.49a5bc7b6 - https://godotengine.org
vulkan: No DRI3 support detected - required for presentation
Note: you can probably enable DRI3 in your Xorg config
ERROR: None of the devices supports both graphics and present queues.
   at: initialize (servers/rendering/rendering_device.cpp:6644)
ERROR: FATAL: Index p_index = 0 is out of bounds (count = 0).
   at: operator[] (./core/templates/local_vector.h:178)

================================================================
handle_crash: Program crashed with signal 4
Engine version: Godot Engine v4.4.1.stable.official (49a5bc7b616bd04689a2c89e89bda41f50241464)
Dumping the backtrace. Please include this when reporting the bug to the project developer.
[1] /lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libc.so.6(+0x38de0) [0x7f57e174cde0] (??:0)
[2] /home/destructor/Downloads/Ð
```
Since 2012, I have been using the Monogame engine on Linux without problem; maybe the requirements for your engine are higher!
